description: Department of Local Government - Summon the meeting to fill the Vacancy arose to the post of Vice Chairman of the Eravur Urban Council at 10.00 a.m. on 08.12.2022
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the summoning of a meeting to fill a vacancy for the post of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Eravur Urban Council). The content specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendment, and concerns the electoral process for a local government position. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
